Extract console interactions into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Move Edith's banners, dividers, error messages, task list rendering, and task mutation confirmations into a dedicated Ui class. This keeps the command loop responsible for orchestration while preserving existing console output. Refresh the captured Java 25 UI test transcript after all planned sessions pass.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task collection into TaskList
commitResults.messageBody: Encapsulate Edith's mutable task collection behind TaskList operations for adding, accessing, removing, sizing, and checking emptiness. Construct it from loaded tasks and provide a read-only snapshot to the existing Storage API, preserving persistence and all console behavior while reducing direct List manipulation in Edith.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract command parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Move command recognition, todo/deadline/event construction, date validation, and task-number parsing from Edith into Parser. Edith now coordinates parsed commands with TaskList, Storage, and Ui while retaining the existing validation messages and command behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Introduce command hierarchy for list and exit
commitResults.messageBody: Add an abstract Command contract and migrate the argument-free list and bye behaviors into ListCommand and ExitCommand. Teach Parser to construct these command objects while Edith temporarily retains its switch for commands that still require migration. This establishes polymorphic execution in a small, behavior-preserving step before moving task-mutating commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task mutation commands
commitResults.messageBody: Move mark, unmark, and delete behavior from Edith into dedicated Command subclasses that carry their parsed task numbers, validate list bounds, perform mutations, persist changes, and display confirmations. Extend Parser's incremental command factory for these types and add an exact UI test covering unmark behavior on restored data.

commitResults.messageTitle: Complete command parsing with AddCommand
commitResults.messageBody: Represent todo, deadline, and event additions with a shared AddCommand that owns insertion, persistence, and confirmation behavior. Consolidate Parser into one parse method that validates input and returns a Command for every supported command type. Remove Edith's remaining command switch and add helper so its loop now only parses, executes, handles errors, and exits.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move application lifecycle into Edith run method
commitResults.messageBody: Give Edith ownership of its Ui and TaskList collaborators, move Scanner-based command reading behind Ui, and introduce a run method with a parse-execute-exit loop. Use a finally block for consistent divider output and reduce main to constructing and running the application while preserving EOF and console behavior.
